- Những lô hàng có giá trị lớn, có nhu c.en: - Large shipments of high value, which require fast freight like fresh flowers, expensive jewelry, should choose to transport by airways will be faster and safer than container transport.

- Những lô hàng có khối lượng rất lớn (t.en: - The shipments have a huge mass (from a few tens of thousands of tons up) such as ore, rice, lime, fertilizer,... would be more suitable for freight by cargo ship.
- Những lô hàng có khối lượng rất lớn (t.zh: - 货运量巨大(从几千吨上方),例如矿石、水稻、石灰、化肥.更适合由货船运输。
